text:
Avery: Quick dumb game — leave a one-line “office fortune” on the yellow Post-it by the kettle. I'll start: “You will find an extra spoon tomorrow.” Ready? 
Sam: Love it. In: “Your next meeting will include an unexpected cookie.” :cookie:
Priya: Okay my entry: “A stapler will reveal its true feelings.” :joy:
Jordan: Also adding a tiny shoutout — Sam handled the billing bug like a pro today, :tada: thanks!
Sam: Thanks! Team effort. Back to fortunes: “Someone will claim the last donut and confess immediately.”
Avery: This is already better than my morning coffee.
bot-coffee: (automated) Coffee refill scheduled at 15:00. ☕
Priya: Bonus rule: if your fortune accidentally rhymes, you win a scribble-drawn trophy.
Jordan: I accidentally wrote a couplet: “Leftover salad finds new fate, fridge magnets negotiate.” do I win?
Sam: 100% trophy. Show us the drawing.
Avery: Prize: one sticker and eternal bragging rights. :sticker:
Priya: small gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/happy-dance-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 :dancer:
Jordan: Also small PSA — if you take the kettle spoon, leave a Post-it fortune in return! :memo:
Sam: Noted. Leaving a fortune now. “May your socks always match on video calls.”
Avery: This thread made my day. Tiny rituals > big memos.
Priya: Agreed. Also kudos to Jordan for starting the sticker stash. :sparkles:
Jordan: blushes :flushed: thanks y'all.
Avery: End of chain for now — someone's coming to collect Post-its into a tiny book tomorrow. Optional autographing welcome.
Sam: I'll bring a pen. 
Priya: I'll bring snacks.
Jordan: I'll bring more stickers.
Avery: Perfect. See you at the kettle. :coffee:
